items: What our forms and the robot's chat collect, why we ask for it, where it goes, and how to have it removed.
Date the wording last changed (year-month-day, like 2026-11-06)

## What we collect
We only collect what you type into one of our forms:
- **The contact page and the order form on the Services page** ask for your name, email address, phone number, country and your message. With it we record the page you sent it from and your browser's user agent (the name and version of your browser and operating system).
- **The enquiry form near the end of most pages** (“Tell us what you'd like to fix”) asks for your name, business email, company, what you need and a line about the problem, and if you like, your WhatsApp number.
- **The chat with the robot in the corner of the screen** starts by asking for your name and a phone number or an email address. After that it keeps what you write to the robot and his answers, what he understood about your project, and the pages you looked at on our website. See “The robot's chat” below.
This website sets no cookies and uses no advertising or tracking tools. It keeps a few small notes in your browser's own storage, which never leave your device: whether the opening animation has played and whether the robot has already greeted you, what he last said, his lines for the pages you've opened, the pages you've looked at and for how long (so he can talk about them), the details you gave him at the start of the chat (so it carries on from page to page until you close the tab), or that you hid him. To see how the site is used, we count visits with Vercel Web Analytics: it records the page visited, the site you came from, your country and your type of device and browser, without cookies and without keeping your IP address, and we only ever see totals. We also count each time one of our forms is sent, without anything you typed into it.

## How we use it
We use your details to read your enquiry and get back to you about it. A message from the contact page or the Services page is saved in our database and emailed to our team, and a copy is emailed to you to confirm that it arrived. An enquiry from the enquiry form is saved in our database and emailed to our team. A chat with the robot is saved in our database too, and our team gets an email when one starts, so they can follow up with you.
We don't sell your details, share them for marketing, or add you to a mailing list.

## The robot's chat
**Your details stay with us.** The name, phone number and email address you give at the start of the chat go only to our own database, where our team sees them with the conversation. They are never sent to the AI: the robot calls you by your name, but our website adds it to his answers after they come back. A phone number or email address you type into the chat is held back from the AI in the same way.
**The robot's answers are written by Google's Gemini AI.** To answer you, our website sends Google what you write in the chat (without the details above), the earlier questions and answers in the same chat, the text of the page you're on, the pages you've looked at on our website this visit and for how long, and what our website already says about IN-TA.
We use Gemini's free service. Under its terms, Google may use what is sent and the answers to improve its products, and people at Google may read them. So **please don't type confidential details into the chat**.
Gemini also writes what the robot does and says on each page while you read it. For that, our website sends Google only the page's own text, never anything about you, and keeps his lines for each page for up to 12 hours so that one set serves every visitor.
**What we keep.** We save the chat in our database: your name and contact details, what you and the robot wrote, what he understood about your project (the service, what you need, your kind of business, when and your budget, if you said), and the pages you looked at. Our team uses it only to get back to you about your enquiry. To have it deleted, email {email}.
To stop the chat being misused, our website counts how many questions come from each IP address over the last day, in its memory only. The chat and Gemini's lines aren't offered in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom or Switzerland, where Google's free service can't be used: our hosting provider tells our website which country a visit comes from, and that isn't stored either.

## Services we use
The site runs on a few outside services, which handle your details only to run it for us:
- **Vercel** hosts this website and counts its visits as described above, and **Render** runs the system that receives the forms.
- **Neon** hosts the database where messages and robot chats are saved.
- **Cloudinary** stores and serves the images on the site.
- **An email service** delivers the emails described above.
- **Google's Gemini API** writes the robot's answers and his lines on each page, as described above.
- **Google Fonts** supplies the site's icons, so your browser asks Google's servers for them and Google sees your IP address.
Links to Google Maps, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X and YouTube take you to those sites, and their own privacy policies apply there.

## Your choices
To see, correct or delete what you've sent us, email {email}.

## Changes to this policy
When this policy changes, we'll update this page and the date at the top.

## Data protection
At IN-TA Solutions, we prioritize the security of your data. We employ industry-standard encryption and security protocols to ensure that your information remains confidential and protected against unauthorized access.

## Secure infrastructure
Our infrastructure is built on world-class cloud providers with robust security measures. We regularly perform security audits and vulnerability assessments to maintain the highest standards of safety.

## Compliance
We adhere to global data protection regulations and standards. Our team is committed to ensuring compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and other relevant privacy laws.

## Report a vulnerability
If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in our systems, please report it to us immediately at {email}.
